sentences.en: Hello, everyone, and welcome to our second drink of Boys and Girls.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到我们的第二款“男孩与女孩”特饮。

sentences.en: This episode is near and dear to our hearts because we got to have all the ladies in scenes together all day.
sentences.zh: 这一集对我们来说意义非凡，因为我们一整天都能让所有的女士们一起出现在同一个场景中。

sentences.en: And this episode was directed by the legendary Denny Gordon.
sentences.zh: 而且这一集是由传奇导演丹尼·戈登执导的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, Boys and Girls is on Dave Rogers' list of favorite Peacock superfan episodes.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，“男孩与女孩”在戴夫·罗杰斯的孔雀台超级粉丝最爱剧集榜单上。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we actually reached out to the director of Boys and Girls, Denny Gordon,
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上联系了“男孩与女孩”的导演丹尼·戈登，

sentences.en: and we are going to have her on Office Ladies as our special guest to talk all about the superfan episode.
sentences.zh: 我们将邀请她作为特邀嘉宾做客“办公室女士”，畅聊关于这一集超级粉丝剪辑版的内容。

sentences.en: I really can't wait for it, and we'll let you know when that's coming out.
sentences.zh: 我真的等不及了，我们会告诉大家这期节目什么时候播出。

sentences.en: So we aren't going to give any new insights on this episode today.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们不会透露关于这一集的任何新见解。

sentences.en: You'll have to wait for our superfan breakdown for that.
sentences.zh: 你们得等我们的超级粉丝深度解析节目了。

sentences.en: But we didn't want to leave you hanging, so I thought we could answer a question from our general mailbox.
sentences.zh: 但我们不想让你们干着急，所以我想我们可以回答一个来自我们公共收件箱的问题。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: This came in from Avery C.
sentences.zh: 这个问题来自弗吉尼亚州里士满的艾弗里·C.

sentences.en: in Richmond, Virginia, who said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: Hello, Jenna and Angela.
sentences.zh: 你好，珍娜和安吉拉。

sentences.en: I would love to know about rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 我很想了解排练的事情。

sentences.en: When did you do rehearsals?
sentences.zh: 你们是什么时候进行排练的？

sentences.en: How did they fit in the general schedule of the week?
sentences.zh: 它们是如何融入一周的整体日程安排中的？

sentences.en: Filming, getting lighting, locations?
sentences.zh: 比如拍摄、打光、选景？

sentences.en: Did you rehearse each scene every day, or did you front load all the rehearsals at the beginning of the week?
sentences.zh: 你们是每天排练每个场景，还是把所有的排练都集中在周初？

sentences.en: Did you wear your costume and makeup for rehearsals or ordinary clothes?
sentences.zh: 排练时你们穿的是戏服和妆容，还是便服？

sentences.en: How long did rehearsals usually take?
sentences.zh: 排练通常需要多长时间？

sentences.en: Basically, Avery wants the full download on rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，艾弗里想全面了解排练的内幕。

sentences.en: Well, Avery, I think this is a great question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，艾弗里，我觉得这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: You know, every single show or movie you work on is a little different.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你参与的每一部电视剧或电影都有点不同。

sentences.en: And our show, we typically did a rehearsal for camera and for the actor and directors,
sentences.zh: 而在我们的剧中，我们通常会为摄影机、演员和导演进行一次排练，

sentences.en: and we weren't always in wardrobe for those.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在排练时并不总是穿着戏服。

sentences.en: Depending on where your call time was and where you were in the mix of the day,
sentences.zh: 这取决于你的通告时间以及你在当天拍摄进度中的位置，

sentences.en: you might be halfway through hair and makeup.
sentences.zh: 你可能做发型和化妆才做到一半。

sentences.en: You might be fully dressed because you had already been in a scene that day.
sentences.zh: 你也可能已经盛装打扮好了，因为那天你已经拍过一场戏了。

sentences.en: But we would always walk through the scene for the camera crew and the lighting crew.
sentences.zh: 但我们总是会为摄影团队和灯光团队走一遍戏。

sentences.en: Yes, and those rehearsals would happen right before we shot that scene.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些排练通常就在我们拍摄那个场景之前进行。

sentences.en: So it's not like we came in on Monday mornings and rehearsed everything in a big clump.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说我们在周一早上来到片场，然后把所有东西都一股脑儿地排练一遍。

sentences.en: Whatever scene we were getting ready to shoot, it would begin with a rehearsal.
sentences.zh: 无论我们准备拍哪个场景，都是从排练开始的。

sentences.en: And we would all sit and sometimes even get out our scripts and read through it,
sentences.zh: 我们都会坐下来，有时甚至拿出剧本通读一遍，

sentences.en: talk about where we thought each person would stand or how they would cross or move,
sentences.zh: 讨论我们认为每个人应该站在哪里，或者他们将如何穿梭或移动，

sentences.en: and play out the beats of the scene.
sentences.zh: 并把场景的节奏演练出来。

sentences.en: Camera would figure out how they were going to cover it.
sentences.zh: 摄影团队会想好他们将如何拍摄这个场景。

sentences.en: And that was the rehearsal.
sentences.zh: 这就是排练。

sentences.en: It was not usually even done for performance.
sentences.zh: 它通常甚至不是为了表演而进行的。

sentences.en: No, hardly ever done for performance.
sentences.zh: 对，几乎从不是为了表演而排练。

sentences.en: Really more of a walkthrough for the crew.
sentences.zh: 真的更像是给工作人员走位用的。

sentences.en: And what I always did when I had bigger scenes with a lot of dialogue is I just rehearsed like
sentences.zh: 而当我遇到有很多台词的大场面时，我通常会做的是在自己的化妆车里疯狂地

sentences.en: crazy on my own in my trailer.
sentences.zh: 独自排练。

sentences.en: Sometimes Jenna and I would meet and run lines together or whoever you might be in a scene with.
sentences.zh: 有时珍娜和我会碰面一起对台词，或者跟你同场飙戏的其他演员。

sentences.en: Phyllis and I, I remember we would rehearse many of our big scenes where
sentences.zh: 我和菲利斯，我记得我们俩会排练很多重头戏，

sentences.en: our two characters had conflict.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们两个角色之间有冲突的戏份。

sentences.en: Well, when you work on a television show or a movie, you are expected to do all of that work at home.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你参与电视剧或电影拍摄时，大家期望你在家里就把所有的准备工作都做好。

sentences.en: That is your homework.
sentences.zh: 那便是你的家庭作业。

sentences.en: You're meant to come in prepared with your lines ready, your choices made.
sentences.zh: 你本该带着准备好的台词和做好的选择来。

sentences.en: The rehearsal process on a movie or a television show is not there for you to make any acting
sentences.zh: 电影或电视剧的排练过程并不是为了让你去做出什么演戏上的

sentences.en: discoveries necessarily.
sentences.zh: 突破或发现。

sentences.en: And sometimes it's your very first time hearing how the other actor in the scene is doing their
sentences.zh: 而且有时这是你第一次听到戏里的另一个演员将如何演绎

sentences.en: part, which is super weird.
sentences.zh: 他们的部分，这感觉超级奇怪。

sentences.en: So, of course, on The Office, we got to know each other so well.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，在《办公室》里，我们彼此了解得太深了。

sentences.en: I could just hear how Angela was going to say it or how Brian Baumgartner was going to say
sentences.zh: 我几乎能预听到安吉拉会怎么说，或者布赖恩·鲍姆加特纳会

sentences.en: something as Kevin.
sentences.zh: 以凯文的口吻说些什么。

sentences.en: But, you know, on other movies, sometimes you're meeting your scene partner that you're supposed
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，在其他电影里，有时你和你的搭档——也就是你们本该

sentences.en: to have this long character history with for the first time in that little rehearsal right
sentences.zh: 有着长久角色背景的搭档——直到开拍前的那场简短排练里才是第一次见面。

sentences.en: before you shoot.
sentences.zh: 就在拍摄前。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But then you do the rehearsal and then there'll be a little break.
sentences.zh: 但接着你们排练完了，然后会有一个短暂的休息。

sentences.en: So you do get a chance to kind of download that information.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实有机会去消化那些信息。

sentences.en: And during that break, you're meant to get into your wardrobe or get your hair and makeup
sentences.zh: 而在那个休息期间，你得去换上戏服，或者让发型和妆容

sentences.en: touched up.
sentences.zh: 补妆修饰一下。

sentences.en: And then that's when the lighting crew will come in and they'll make sure that everything's
sentences.zh: 然后灯光组会进来，确保

sentences.en: ready.
sentences.zh: 一切都准备就绪。

sentences.en: And that's about a 30-minute break on our set, sometimes less.
sentences.zh: 在我们剧组，那大约是30分钟的休息时间，有时甚至更短。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And sometimes the physicality of the scene doesn't end up being the way you thought it was going
sentences.zh: 而且有时这场戏的形体动作，最后呈现出来的方式

sentences.en: to be.
sentences.zh: 并不像你之前想象的那样。

sentences.en: I remember there was a scene from accounting where I interject into a conversation that's
sentences.zh: 我记得会计部有一场戏，我插话进了一场

sentences.en: happening in the bullpen.
sentences.zh: 正在办公大厅发生的对话。

sentences.en: And when I read it, I thought, oh, I'd probably get up and I walk over to the bullpen.
sentences.zh: 当我读剧本时，我想，哦，我可能会站起来，走到办公大厅去。

sentences.en: But the way they were framing the wide shot, Randall Einhorn had me yell my line from accounting.
sentences.zh: 但由于他们构图远景的方式，兰德尔·艾因霍恩让我直接从会计部大喊我的台词。

sentences.en: And that sort of changed how I said it.
sentences.zh: 这就改变了我说话的方式。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It had a bigger presence in the room.
sentences.zh: 它在整个房间里更有存在感了。

sentences.en: So you kind of have to have some flexibility in how you rehearsed it on your own at home
sentences.zh: 所以你多少得具备一些灵活性，把你自己在家排练的方式

sentences.en: into how it's going to end up being that day on set.
sentences.zh: 调整为那天在片场最终呈现的效果。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, Avery, thank you for that question.
sentences.zh: 好的，埃弗里，谢谢你的提问。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for writing in.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你写信来。

sentences.zh: 并且请务必在今年晚些时候收看我们对《男孩与女孩》的Peacock超级粉丝剖析节目，

sentences.zh: 但首先，这是我们对《男孩与女孩》的原创剖析节目。

sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍。

sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.zh: 现在我们为你专门制作了《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享独家的幕后故事，

sentences.zh: 今天，我们来聊聊《男孩与女孩》。

sentences.zh: 简和《办公室》的女员工们一起主持了一场职场女性研讨会。

sentences.en: But Michael feels threatened.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔感到受到了威胁。

sentences.zh: 于是他决定在仓库里搞一个针锋相对的职场男性研讨会，

sentences.en: which he slowly destroys.
sentences.zh: 结果被他一点点搞砸了。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one, fan question from Dan Felve.
sentences.zh: 趣味冷知识一，来自粉丝丹·费尔维的提问。

sentences.en: Was the idea for this episode based on anything that anyone went through, like in a previous job?
sentences.zh: 这一集的创意是基于任何人经历过的事情吗，比如在以前的工作中？

sentences.en: No, Dan.
sentences.zh: 没有，丹。

sentences.en: It's based on an idea that Angela and I pitched.
sentences.zh: 这是基于我和安吉拉提出过的一个创意。

sentences.en: That's right, Dan.
sentences.zh: 没错，丹。

sentences.en: Woo!
sentences.zh: 呜！

sentences.en: Dan.
sentences.zh: 丹。

sentences.en: This is our proudest moment.
sentences.zh: 这是我们最自豪的时刻。

sentences.en: We love this.
sentences.zh: 我们太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: We love this.
sentences.zh: 我们太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: Also, we love that Greg Daniels was so collaborative, right?
sentences.zh: 还有，我们很喜欢格雷格·丹尼尔斯那么有合作精神，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That we could have this idea.
sentences.zh: 我们能有这个创意。

sentences.en: So, you know, Jen and I both worked in corporate America.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，珍和我都在美国企业界工作过。

sentences.en: And so we both had to go to a lot of like human resource meetings and things like that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都不得不参加很多类似人力资源会议之类的事情。

sentences.en: And we were on set one day sort of talking about it.
sentences.zh: 有一天我们在片场不知怎么就聊到了这个。

sentences.en: And I wrote about it in my journal.
sentences.zh: 我在日记里写下了这件事。

sentences.en: Lady, I did too.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我也写了。

sentences.en: I wrote on Thursday, February 2nd, 2006,
sentences.zh: 我写道，2006年2月2日，星期四，

sentences.en: Boys and Girls, there are many things I love about working on this show.
sentences.zh: 《男孩与女孩》，能参演这部剧有许多我喜欢的地方。

sentences.en: But one of the coolest is the creative input that we get to have.
sentences.zh: 但最酷的事情之一就是我们能有创作上的投入。

sentences.en: A lot of shows just don't let their actors get involved that way.
sentences.zh: 很多剧集就是不让演员以那种方式参与进来。

sentences.en: But Jen and I were talking about our lives before the show, when she was a secretary and I was an operator.
sentences.zh: 但珍和我当时在聊我们拍戏前的生活，当时她是秘书，我是接线员。

sentences.en: And we were laughing about all the crazy seminars and ridiculous meetings we had to sit through at our old corporate jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们在笑谈以前在公司工作时不得不坐着听的那些疯狂的研讨会和荒谬的会议。

sentences.en: We sort of had this idea that it would be a funny episode called Women in the Workplace.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有了这样一个想法，觉得拍一集名叫《职场女性》的剧会很有趣。

sentences.en: We ran into Greg Daniels and told him our little idea.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了格雷格·丹尼尔斯，把我们的这个小想法告诉了他。

sentences.en: We didn't have anything fleshed out or written down.
sentences.zh: 我们当时没有任何具体的细节或文字记录。

sentences.en: And he got so excited.
sentences.zh: 而他兴奋极了。

sentences.en: He grabbed BJ and he said, start writing this down.
sentences.zh: 他抓住BJ说，快把这个记下来。

sentences.en: And BJ got a notepad and started jotting things down.
sentences.zh: BJ于是拿出一个记事本开始记下一些东西。

sentences.en: Greg started scribbling notes too.
sentences.zh: 格雷格也开始飞速记笔记。

sentences.en: Weeks later, BJ Novak wrote this awesome script.
sentences.zh: 几周后，BJ·诺瓦克写出了这个棒极了的剧本。

sentences.en: Jen and I were so excited.
sentences.zh: 珍和我当时兴奋极了。

sentences.en: We are so lucky to be a part of a show that would respect our ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们太幸运了，能参演一部尊重我们想法的剧集。

sentences.en: Oh, that is so nice.
sentences.zh: 哦，这太好了。

sentences.en: You wrote mostly about the collaboration.
sentences.zh: 你写的内容主要关于合作。

sentences.en: I wrote very differently about this in my journal.
sentences.zh: 我在日记里对此有截然不同的记录。

sentences.en: Wait, can I say the last thing I wrote was,
sentences.zh: 等等，我能说我写的最后一句是，

sentences.en: to any of the writers out there,
sentences.zh: 致所有的编剧们，

sentences.en: we're not going to get in the habit of just bugging you guys with ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们不会养成经常用想法去烦你们的习惯。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: We would always have these bright ideas as a cast,
sentences.zh: 我们作为演员总会有这些绝妙的想法，

sentences.en: and we always worried that we annoyed the writers.

sentences.en: Office Ladies is a presentation of Odyssey and is produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》是Odyssey呈献的节目，由珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金西制作。

sentences.en: Our executive producer is Cassie Jerkins, and our audio engineer and associate producer is Daniela Silva.
sentences.zh: 我们的执行制片人是卡西·杰金斯，我们的音频工程师兼副制片人是丹妮拉·席尔瓦。

sentences.en: Odyssey's executive producers are Jenna Wise-Berman and Leah Reese Dennis.
sentences.zh: Odyssey的执行制片人是珍娜·怀斯-伯曼和莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Office Ladies is mixed and mastered by Chris Basil.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由克里斯·巴塞尔进行混音和母带处理。

sentences.en: Our theme song is Rubber Tree by Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿创作的《橡胶树》。
